record.question: Which country in the world is the first to declare a climate emergency?
record.explanation: Answer B: Britain. The UK Parliament declared a climate emergency in May 2019; Britain/UK was the first national parliament to do so among these choices. Reference: https://hansard.parliament.uk/commons/2019-05-01/debates/2E1A4F34-5B4C-4532-8E2F-334DDA8A9F5A/ClimateChange. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: August 2019 (cover; exact day not stated). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
